# Would your documentation hold up in a survey?

voize helps nursing teams create timely, complete, and defensible documentation during the shift, so your facility is better prepared when surveyors ask for proof.

Nurses and caregivers speak naturally in the moment of care, and voize creates comprehensive, timely documentation that syncs to your existing EHR in real time.

Care, unburdened

Seamless charting creates better care.

Shifts run smoother, care feels easier, and nurses can get back to doing what they love.

![Ältere Frau mit weißem Haar betrachtet sich in einem kleinen Handspiegel, während eine Pflegerin sie lächelnd unterstützt.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69d7bc23bce852505d9de7b8_quotes-03.avif)

More care time, less overtime

voize integrates charting directly into nurses' workflows, giving back 5+ hours per week. This means less after-hours admin and more time with patients.

![Eine Pflegekraft mit medizinischen Handschuhen nutzt die digitale Pflegedokumentations-App von voize auf einem Smartphone, im Hintergrund liegt medizinisches Zubehör wie ein Blutzuckermessgerät.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69e4ae40d118d4aaad235c0c_voize%20App%20Gewicht.avif)

Happier nurses, higher retention

Burnout is the leading cause of turnover for caregivers. With voize, there’s no end-of-shift charting stress, no struggling to keep mental notes.

‍

Caregivers are more present with their patients, [increasing workplace satisfaction](https://www.voize.ai/us/customer-stories/seniorenhilfe-smmp) for valued team members.

![Vier medizinische Fachkräfte in Arbeitskleidung unterhalten sich in einem hellen Flur.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69d7943a9af5e1dea461cdfd_solution-03.avif)

Accurate charting, better reimbursement

Charting done hours after care can miss details that matter. When charting happens in the moment, entries are comprehensive, accurate, and compliant.

‍

That means fewer rejected claims, more accurate reimbursement rates that reflect the care delivered and built-in CMS survey-readiness.

![Sanfter Farbverlauf von Blau links zu Orange rechts mit weißem Übergang in der Mitte.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69bc856abf567f34010462f0_gradient-01.avif)

Proven results

## Care with a positive ROI.

Easing the documentation burden on nurses not only gives them back their time, it reduces overtime and boosts employee satisfaction. That translates into higher retention rates, lower turnover costs, and lower workforce costs.

HOW IT WORKS

Meet the newest member of your nursing team.

Seamless integration into day-to-day workflows means voize becomes the companion nurses can’t live without.

![A nurse looks at a smartphone in a corridor and illustrates how to use the VOIZE app for digital care documentation.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69e4b0d5d087f9d9d2f167b5_Home-voize_Pflegekraft_Sprache_Smartphone.webp)

![Frau blickt auf ein Smartphone mit einer geöffneten Chat-App.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69df834ff4ba73914260abca_Home-voize_Pflegekraft_Sprache_Smartphone-1.avif)

![Person, die ein Smartphone in der Hand hält und eine Nachricht oder App mit Text liest.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69df83b68756f8987ae8c490_Home-voize_Pflegekraft_Sprache_Smartphone_2.avif)

![A nurse looks at a smartphone in a corridor and illustrates how to use the VOIZE app for digital care documentation.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69e4b0d5d087f9d9d2f167b5_Home-voize_Pflegekraft_Sprache_Smartphone.webp)

Step 1

### All your patients, at a glance.

Log into voize on your mobile device. Residents’ profiles, care plans, medications, and tasks are all quickly accessible in an intuitive interface.

Step 2

### Speak naturally,   voize documents as you work.

Patient names are recognized, care notes and data points are structured, and documentation is comprehensive.

Step 3

### Review and approve.

Nurses stay in control. Easily edit and approve charting entries directly on your mobile device.

Step 4

### Sign off. You’re done.

Updated documentation instantly appears across shifts, profiles, and devices.

Why voize?

voize is the companion for caregivers.

Purpose-built for skilled nursing and long-term care facilities, voize is trained on clinical terminology, nursing workflows, and the documentation demands of long-term care.

voize was created to reduce the burden of documentation and improve care delivery so shifts run seamlessly, allowing caregivers to spend more time where it matters.

Speech documentation

Offline capabilities

Name recognition

EHR synchronization

Real-time sync

Grammar correction

### Natural speech becomes structured documentation.

voize is more than just a scribe. Caregivers speech becomes structured, compliant documentation categorized into relevant forms, such as vital signs, fluid intake, and care reports.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bc75a7ad2c638228e917c1/6a85ba18a1b892de61bac71c_voize-speech-documentation.webp)

### Online or Offline.

Care doesn’t wait for a network connection and neither does voize. Our app functions offline and syncs in the background as soon as a connection becomes available.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bc75a7ad2c638228e917c1/6a85ba464217bf418a3f51f3_voize-offline-capabilities.webp)

### Name recognition

In everyday care, every name matters. voize reliably recognizes residents and assigns documentation to the right person.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bc75a7ad2c638228e917c1/6a85ba6d1c8767007335c60f_voize-name-recognition.webp)

### EHR System Synchronization

voize works inside, not just alongside, your facility’s existing EHR system. Entries immediately land where they belong, without detours or need for duplicate documentation.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bc75a7ad2c638228e917c1/6a85b9cef688f55caad5f484_voize-ehr-system-sync.webp)

### voize Gateway

No need for manual follow-ups. No time delay when entering notes. Once the entry is confirmed, it instantaneously appears across shifts, profiles, and devices.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bc75a7ad2c638228e917c1/6a982564acfe1c0114380750_voize-gateway-real-time-sync.webp)

### Grammar correction

Speaking is easier than typing. With voize, natural language is assisted by grammar correction, supporting non-native speakers in documentation.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bc75a7ad2c638228e917c1/6a85bac8d4e48f1176578097_voize-grammar-correction.webp)

## FAQ

### What exactly is voize?

voize is a voice documentation app built specifically for long-term care and skilled nursing facilities. Caregivers simply speak into a phone throughout their shift, and voize’s AI converts their speech into structured EHR data entries. The result is better, more complete documentation, less time behind a computer, and more time providing care.

### How does voize handle different accents?

voize is purpose-built for international clinical settings, and handles everything from Southern accents to non-native English speakers. Our models are continuously learning from actual usage, and caregivers can always review and edit notes before they're finalized.

### How can I learn more?

You can [schedule a demo here](https://www.voize.ai/us/book-a-demo), or give us a ring at [+1(646)480-7479](tel:+1(646)480-7479).

### Does voize integrate with our EHR?

Yes! voize integrates directly with all major EHRs for skilled nursing and long-term care facilities. Integration is bi-directional.

‍

### Does the AI fix my grammar or change what I say?

voize does clean up grammatical issues, and maps your speech to fixed data fields. It does not add or assume any information. All data entries need to be approved (or edited) by the caregiver on the device- there’s always a human in the loop.

### Will my staff actually use voize?

Our record speaks for itself: 96% of voize users continue to use voize daily long after onboarding. Over 200,000 nurses and CNAs use voize globally, and because speaking is faster and more natural than typing, most staff prefer voize within days.

‍

### What devices does voize work with?

voize works with any iPhone or Android from the last 5 years.

### Do I need phone lines? What if my facility’s WiFi goes down?

No phone lines necessary! voize works with WiFi, and even works offline if the wifi goes down or is spotty.

### How are the phones managed?

Phones are owned and managed by the facility, and voize works with your IT department to set up proper Mobile Device Management (MDM). This means you can ensure the phones aren’t used for other purposes, and can’t be used off-site or otherwise grow legs.

### Is voize HIPAA compliant, and do you sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA)?

Yes. voize acts as a Business Associate under HIPAA when providing services to US healthcare customers, and we sign a Business Associate Agreement with every covered entity before processing any Protected Health Information (PHI).

Our standard US deployment is designed so that PHI stays where care happens, not in our cloud: speech recognition and documentation are processed on the caregiver's device, and the structured documentation is transmitted directly into the customer's EHR. Where US backend services are required (e.g. device and user management), they run in regions chosen to align with HIPAA expectations.

Our internal HIPAA program covers the Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification Rules, including administrative, physical, and technical safeguards (access controls, audit logging, encryption, workforce training, incident response). Our BAA with AWS as our underlying cloud provider has been executed.
